homepage.hero.tagline.message: A multi-dialect SQL parsing engine and toolkit

homepage.hero.desc.message: Table & column lineage · Table/DDL parsing · Function extraction · SQL splitting and row-level permission rewriting

homepage.features.heading.message: One engine for the full SQL parsing pipeline

homepage.feature.dialect.desc.message: Route Druid dialects via DbType with a unified AST, covering 15+ datasources.

homepage.feature.lineage.desc.message: Table and column lineage across JOIN, UNION, subqueries, aggregates and CTEs.

homepage.feature.table.desc.message: Identify real tables, CTEs, CREATE TABLE, partitions and table properties.

homepage.feature.function.desc.message: Extract regular, aggregate, window and nested functions with their arguments.

homepage.feature.split.desc.message: Split multi-statement scripts, validate syntax and rewrite row-level permissions.

homepage.feature.arch.desc.message: Syntax differences extend the syntax layer, business differences the core layer, via unified points.

homepage.case.arch.desc.message: The syntax layer extends dialect Lexer/Parser/AST on Druid; the business layer extends parsing, lineage and rewriting via the ISqlParser contract, aligned by DbType and AST.

homepage.case.version.desc.message: Switch version (1.0 / Next) and language (简体中文 / English) from the navbar.
